'''Onin''' or '''Onim''' is a dialect of [[Sekar Onim language]],<ref name="Peta Bahasa o508">{{cite web | title=Sekar-Onim | website=Peta Bahasa | url=https://petabahasa.kemdikbud.go.id/infobahasa.php?idb=702#:~:text=Bahasa%20Sekar%2DOnim%20dituturkan%20di,perbedaan%20sebesar%2078%2C75%25. | language=id | access-date=2024-03-19}}</ref> an [[Austronesian language]] of the [[Onin Peninsula]] in [[Bomberai Peninsula|Bomberai]], [[West Papua Province|West Papua]]. Despite the small number of speakers, it is the basis of a local [[pidgin]].<ref>{{e18|onx|Pidgin Onin}}</ref>

It has 18 consonants and 5 vowels.<ref>{{Cite web |title=OLAC resources |url=http://www.language-archives.org/language/oni |archive-url=}}</ref>
